_comment: Mutation testing on the deterministic logic only — popover-reducer (state machine) and caret (math). React glue is excluded because component tests are timing-coupled and flaky under mutation. Run nightly via .github/workflows/mutation.yml; locally via `bun run test:mutation`. packageManager is omitted because the project uses bun; Stryker's value is informational and bun is not in its enum. plugins[] uses the bare package name instead of the default `@stryker-mutator/*` glob — bun's content-addressable hoisting (`node_modules/.bun/...`) means `core` and `vitest-runner` live in different sibling directories, and Stryker's glob-based discovery looks at `core`'s siblings only. Bare names route through Node's module resolver and work correctly.
